subject: Multi-region staging: slate timing, asset handoff & speaker release confirmations
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@brightstream.events>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Staging windows & final assets for Oct 8 co-branded webinar

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for partnering on the Oct 8 session. Our production lead asked me to circle back with a single checklist so we can lock the staging windows per region and confirm we have signed speaker release forms for all presenters. Two things we need from Redwood:

- Confirmation of region-specific slate handoff times (we're doing NA / LATAM / EMEA staggered start to respect local prime time). NA will start at 11:00 PT, but we need an explicit encoder handover window for each region.
- Copy of the signed speaker releases and any guidance on thumbnail/logo placement & watermarking (BrightStream needs final assets by Oct 4 to prep the landing pages).

Attached is our proposed run_of_show_v3 (minor tweaks from the last version). Can you confirm who will be the on-call for encoder switchover and whether Redwood will apply the sponsor lower-third or if we should ship premade video overlays?

We also have a compliance ask: BrightStream is requesting a 72-hour embargo window for raw recordings (we'll only publish edited clips after that). Does Redwood have any retention/auto-delete policies that would conflict with that?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alex
Production Manager
BrightStream Events

Attachments: run_of_show_v3.xlsx

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@brightstream.events>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T12:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging windows & final assets for Oct 8 co-branded webinar

Alex —

Thanks for the clear checklist and the run-of-show. Quick answers up front:

- Staging handoff windows: Redwood Ops will provide encoder key rotation and slate handoff at these windows (local times converted below):
  * NA (11:00 PT start): encoder handoff 10:45–10:55 PT (UTC-7)
  * LATAM (same stream, delayed): encoder handoff 12:30–12:40 PT (we'll trigger the simulcast replay)
  * EMEA (staggered simulcast): encoder handoff 18:50–19:00 CEST (we will do a region-specific mux and watermark).

- On-call for switchovers: Marissa Cole will be primary ops lead, I'll be backup for escalation. Marissa, confirm you have the RTMP credentials and the test time window on Oct 6 09:00–10:00 PT.

- Speaker releases: we need signed PDFs for all presenters. Laura — can you confirm legal signoff on the attached release template and confirm whether we can host signed copies in Redwood's secure S3 bucket (scoped to the event team) for 90 days?

- Thumbnail/logo/watermark guidance: see attachment thumbnail_guidelines.pdf. Redwood can apply a thin sponsor lower-third at encode time if you provide the layered PNGs (48-bit). If you prefer to ship overlays, please deliver them as MOV/ProRes with alpha channel by Oct 4.

- Embargo/retention: 72-hour embargo is fine. Redwood will hold raw recordings for 7 days by default; we can set an event-level retention override to 9 days to give BrightStream time for edits. Please confirm this is acceptable.

I'll also attach encoder_profiles.txt (profiles we recommend) and a short checklist for the Oct 6 staging test.

Thanks —
Logan
Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: encoder_profiles.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@brightstream.events>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T14:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging windows & final assets for Oct 8 co-branded webinar

On Sep 30, 2026, at 12:08 PM, Logan Wright wrote:
> - On-call for switchovers: Marissa Cole will be primary ops lead, I'll be backup for escalation. Marissa, confirm you have the RTMP credentials and the test time window on Oct 6 09:00–10:00 PT.

Confirmed — I have the RTMP keys and I'll provision temporary test keys for Oct 6. A few operational notes for BrightStream team before the run: 

1) Staging test plan (Oct 6 09:00–10:00 PT):
   - 09:00: dry-run ingest (guest presenters, 5 min each)
   - 09:20: slate handoff simulation (NA -> LATAM delayed ingest)
   - 09:35: watermark/overlay test for sponsor lower-third
   - 09:45: recording retrieval test (BrightStream to pull the raw file from our S3 test bucket)

2) Encoder profiles: Use profile "RS-HQ-30" for presenters with slides; "RS-LQ-20" for panel-only streams to reduce bandwidth. I attached encoder_profiles.txt with exact ffmpeg flags.

3) Overlays & thumbnails: If you send overlays as PNGs, please follow the 1920x1080@30fps spec. For thumbnails, send both 16:9 (1280x720) and 1:1 (1200x1200) for social. We will not auto-apply logos to thumbnails — BrightStream should provide final approved thumbnails by Oct 4.

4) Retention/embargo: Logan is right — we can set a 9-day retention for the event artifacts; however, if you need a shorter or custom retention window for compliance records, let Laura and I know and we will log a ticket to Security.

I'll be on call for Oct 6 and Oct 8. My cell is +1-415-555-0147 for any real-time switchover.

Marissa
Senior Events Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: encoder_profiles.txt

From: Alex Rivera <alex@brightstream.events>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, production@brightstream.events
Date: 2026-10-01T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staging windows & final assets for Oct 8 co-branded webinar

Logan / Marissa / Laura —

Thanks — this all looks good. Quick confirmations from our side:

- We've signed and attached the speaker release for JD Park (attached). We'll get the remaining presenters to you by Oct 3.
- BrightStream will provide layered sponsor lower-thirds in ProRes with alpha by Oct 4 and final thumbnails (both sizes) by Oct 4.
- 9-day retention is acceptable; we'll request an export copy of the raw files within 48 hours and then complete edits before the 72-hour embargo lifts.

We'll run the Oct 6 test as scheduled and publish results to the Drive link you shared. Looking forward to the test.

Best,
Alex
Production Manager
BrightStream Events

Attachments: speaker_release_jd_signed.pdf
